subject: Slot confirmation: scaling walkthrough & token-throughput rehearsal
messages:
From: Sasha Li <sasha@bluesky.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@bluesky.ai
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: architecture walkthrough + live token-throughput rehearsal

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week. BlueSky's engineering team wants a technical deep-dive focused on whether Redwood's serving runtime can hit our 120k tokens/min sustained target for our QA workload and how fallbacks would behave under region failover. We're hoping for a combined architecture review and a short live rehearsal (load kilobytes of synthetic traffic plus a KV-cache warmup) so our SREs can validate the runbook.

Can you propose 2–3 slots next week? Our timezone is US-EAST (UTC-4). Ideal window: mornings for us (13:00–17:00 UTC). Also attached is a short matrix of the token targets we've been using.

Thanks,
Sasha
Head of Infrastructure, BlueSky AI
Attachment: token_target_matrix.csv (csv, 14KB)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Li <sasha@bluesky.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: architecture walkthrough + live token-throughput rehearsal

Hi Sasha — happy to run this. Proposed slots (all UTC):
• Wed 2026-08-26 14:00–15:30 (architecture + 30m rehearsal)
• Thu 2026-08-27 15:00–16:30 (same)
• Mon 2026-08-30 13:00–14:30 (backup)

Quick ask from our side to make the session effective:
1) Confirm the target distribution (120k tokens/min sustained, 95thpct latency <= 350ms) — we saw your CSV but want the final numbers.
2) Tell us your preferred model size and sequence length distribution for the rehearsal (we'll provision a compatible variant).
3) Share any corporate security requirements (IP allowlist, certs) so the Private demo environment can be prepped.

I'll attach a starter runbook and a checklist; Aditya, can you confirm GPU reservation sizes and whether a KV-cache prefill will be needed? Irene/Karthik — can you note any topology constraints (multi-region failover rehearsal)?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: prelim_runbook_v1.pdf (stub), session_checklist.txt (stub)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: architecture walkthrough + live token-throughput rehearsal

Monica — confirming we can reserve a Dedicated pool for the rehearsal windows. Notes: 
• Baseline plan: 8x A100 equivalent nodes with continuous batching enabled; should reach ~130k tokens/min for the 1.5k sequence mix in Sasha's CSV after KV warmup.
• KV-cache warmup: recommend a 10–15 minute prefill at low concurrency to reach steady-state; we'll script this.
• Telemetry: we'll stream token-level latencies to a temporary Grafana dashboard for BlueSky SREs.

Risks to flag: multi-region failover will add cold-cache penalties; for the rehearsal we can run a controlled failover step but expect a transient latency spike (x2–x3) until KV warms.

I'll attach a short GPU-capacity summary and the prefill script stub.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Performance Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: gpu_capacity_summary.txt (stub)
From: Sasha Li <sasha@bluesky.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@bluesky.ai
Date: Fri, 29 Aug 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: architecture walkthrough + live token-throughput rehearsal

Monica / team — thanks for the quick turn. We can take Wed 2026-08-26 14:00 UTC (your first choice) — that works for three of our SRE leads; we also reserve Thu 2026-08-27 15:00 UTC as backup. Confirming targets: 120000 tokens/min sustained, 95th percentile latency target 350ms. Sequence mix: 60% short (<=256), 30% medium (256–1024), 10% long (>=1024).

Pre-demo asks from us:
• Please send the final runbook and prefill script by EOD Monday (2026-08-24) so our SREs can review.
• We require an IP allowlist entry for our control-plane collector: 34.210.12.98/32.
• Please share the Grafana read-only URL and a HubSpot demo record link in the calendar invite.

I'll also upload a short SOC notes doc if your team wants it ahead of time. We look forward to the rehearsal.

Best,
Sasha Li
Head of Infrastructure, BlueSky AI
Attachment: soc_notes_brief.pdf (stub)
